prox.label: Proximity
prox.blurb: Walk over. Bandwidth −2. No escalation. Undefeated.
prox.blurbBlocked: You are too far away. Walk within {range}m first.

toast.title: Proximity
toast.body: You walk over. Nothing is said. It stops. It always works and it is always boring.

pause.label: The pause
pause.blurb: Stop mid-sentence and wait. Costs tempo. Mastery −1.

toast.title: The pause
toast.body: You stop mid-sentence. The room finds itself. Eleven heads turn toward the silence.

call.label: Public callout
call.blurb: Free, fast, and the whole room watches you do it.

toast.title: Public callout
toast.body: Instant compliance. Rapport −4. Two other kids quietly decide something about you.

toast.title: Escalation
toast.body: "I wasn't even DOING anything." Now everyone is in it. This is going to take four minutes to come back from.

bank.label: Bank it
bank.blurb: Say nothing. Remember it. Adds to your leverage file.

toast.title: Banked
toast.body: Filed. Useful in a conference. Useless in about three weeks.

toast.title: They noticed you noticed
toast.body: And they noticed you chose not to. That is worth something.

elseToast.title: It spreads
elseToast.body: It does not stop. Two desks over, someone else starts.

quiet.label: The quiet word later
quiet.blurb: Costs your passing time. Bandwidth −4. Rapport +5.
quiet.leverage: {name} — talk to her at the door Friday

toast.title: You'll catch her at the door
toast.body: Nothing changes in the next thirty minutes. Something changes.

let.blurb: Free. She keeps the phone. The lesson continues.

toast.title: You let it go
toast.body: She keeps the phone. You keep teaching. Both of those were choices.

call.blurb: Immediate compliance. You will think about this tonight.

toast.title: That landed badly
toast.body: She puts it away immediately and does not look up again for the rest of the period.

toast.title: It is a granola bar
toast.body: You crossed the room for a granola bar. The class saw you do it. Rapport −4.

toast.title: It is a granola bar
toast.body: You crossed the room for a granola bar. The class saw you do it. Rapport −4.

toast.title: Banked
toast.body: You have written down that {name} was eating a granola bar. For later. For some reason.

toast.title: Nothing there
toast.body: You let it go, and it was nothing. Some of the pressure comes off.
